get.summary:
GetAuthContext returns authorization context for the authenticated caller and selected
project.

404.description: Caller or project no longer exists.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the project for which authorization context is resolved.

post.summary:
RequestMagicLink sends a sign-in link when the given email address belongs to a provisioned
user and is not rate-limited. An unknown address is not provisioned and receives no email.
Both cases return success so callers cannot determine whether the address is registered.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for RequestMagicLink.

parameters.name: x-idempotency-key
parameters.description: A client-generated UUID. Retrying the same request with the same key returns the original result instead of sending a second sign-in email.

post.summary:
RefreshAccessToken rotates the refresh token and issues a new token pair.
The supplied refresh token is revoked upon success.

401.description: Refresh token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for RefreshAccessToken.

post.summary: RevokeRefreshToken invalidates a refresh token, ending the session.

404.description: Refresh token does not exist or was already revoked.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for RevokeRefreshToken.

post.summary:
RevokeAllSessions revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user, ending all sessions.
Requires a valid access token.
VerifyMagicLink exchanges a magic-link token for an access/refresh token pair.

401.description: Magic-link token is invalid or expired.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for VerifyMagicLink.

get.summary: Lists a user's organization-scoped custom-role assignments.

400.description: Invalid user ID, pagination, or project metadata.

404.description: User or organization membership not found.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user whose assignments to list.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of assignments to return.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of a project in the organization whose assignments to list.

post.summary: Creates an organization with a control project and a named default project.

400.description: gRPC INVALID_ARGUMENT. A default project name that conflicts with the control project includes ErrorDetail.code ERROR_CODE_CONTROL_PROJECT_NAME_CONFLICT; ordinary validation errors do not include an application error code.

403.description: Organization creation authority or system-organization membership is missing.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for creating an organization.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the system organization's control project.

get.summary: Lists users belonging to the organization selected through its control project.

400.description: Invalid pagination, filtering, or project metadata.

403.description: Organization-user read access is missing or the selected project is not the organization's control project.

404.description: Filtered project not found in the organization.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of users to return. Defaults to 50 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque token returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: filter.projectId
parameters.description: Restrict results to organization members with effective access to this project.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the organization control project.

post.summary:
Creates a system user when needed and adds that user to the organization selected through
its control project.

403.description: Organization-user creation access is missing or the selected project is not the organization's control project.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for creating or assigning an organization user.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the organization control project.
